title: Aise hum saqiye kausar ki taraf dekhte hai
body:
Aise hum saqiye kausar ki taraf dekhte hai
Ya ali.. ya ali...Ya ali.. ya ali.....
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya ali.. ya ali... ya ali.. ya aliii...
Aise hum saqiye kausar ki taraf dekhte hai..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis tarha pyaase..(2) samandar ki taraf dekhte hai
1. Yaad aata hai hume 13 rajab ka manzar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab bhi Allah.. (2) tere ghar ki taraf dekhte hai
2. Khud samajh jaata hai malik ka ishara malik..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
bus ali malik e ashtar ki taraf dekhte hai
3. Ayatein ho ya Mohammad ho amaa'n ki khatir..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Fatima zehra..(2) ki chadar ki taraf dekhte hai
4. Jab nuseri mere maula ko khuda kehta hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
has ke salmaan abuzar ki taraf dekhte hai
5. Hausla apna badhane ke liye mushkil mein..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
ambiya khud..(2) ali asghar ki taraf dekhte hai
6. Ruk jaa aye maut ziyarat ka maza lene de..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
hum abhi chehra e ..(2) Haider ki taraf dekhte hai
7. Lafz khud aale Mohammad ki sana mein akbar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
jod kar hath sukhanwar ki taraf dekhte hai
Aise hum saqiye kausar ki taraf dekhte hai..(2)
author: Mir Hassan Mir
